raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 was delivered twice (ingest_ts 02:00 and 05:00), so 333 raw txn_ids have exact duplicate rows that differ only in ingest_ts. silver_transactions has no dedup, so every downstream gold table double-counts those transactions. Deduplicating by txn_id in silver fixes all of them.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.95,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC) = 1"}}
